gen-gf-castoro-titling-lora: Hairline joins like pulled wire hang off heavy columns in Castoro Titling. And Lora does the quiet work of reading, its thin lines sturdy against heavier thick ones, while the heading stays best at a quick glance.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-epunda-slab: Horseshoe curves and big swagger define Cherry Swash, whose terminals end just as wide as they began. And Epunda Slab, dignified with its gaping c and rounded lowercase, sits beside it like a quieter, more formal relative.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-fauna-one: A horseshoe-wide c marks Cherry Swash at once. Fauna One, with a generous entry into the e's eye and shallow ascenders and descenders, settles into a literary, dignified murmur page after page.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-glegoo: Glegoo reads refined and editorial, its big counters and wide, unclosed mouths on curved letters letting light in. But Cherry Swash, with no pinched joints or flared ends, would lose its swagger if shrunk small.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-hanuman: Cherry Swash bends its c open like a horseshoe and keeps a single line weight, which gives it a commanding look. Cherry Swash grabs attention; Hanuman, high-waisted and refined, does the patient reading.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla reads refined and authoritative, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals and its e opened like a pried clasp. And after Cherry Swash's horseshoe c, whole paragraphs of it would move along with quiet authority.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-slabo-13px: Loud horseshoe curves, diagonals matching the verticals: that's Cherry Swash making an entrance. And Slabo 13px settles in beneath, bookish and dignified, with generous counters and clear openings in its rounded letters.
gen-gf-chilanka-fs-plein: A clear channel leads into every round letter, so the body text reads reliably and clean. Plein is made for brief visits rather than marathons, with Chilanka's graceful, uniform strokes keeping things relaxed.
gen-gf-chilanka-outfit: Outfit finishes its curves well before they close, with no swelling or thinning, like cable bent into shapes. Outfit handles the everyday text, clean and approachable, while Chilanka's relaxed hand wouldn't hold up through lengthy blocks.
gen-gf-chilanka-plus-jakarta-sans: Chilanka has a relaxed, hand-drawn line of unvarying thickness, best taken in quick glimpses. Plus Jakarta Sans adds a modern, precise counterweight, its monoline curves ending well apart, to that loose handwriting.
